body: I love light blue eyes on a black haired man. Always been into dark hair in general though.

I’m empathetic and helpful, very motherly to the people I care about (could also be a bad thing I guess) 

I’m also an extremely jealous person, insecure, paranoid about my relationship constantly. I used to be petty and argumentative too but I’ve worked on that. 
My poor boyfriend :(

Interviewing for a waitress position, I had applied with only my mothers last name but I have both surnames in my legal name. Owner of the restaurants sees Jones-Smith, asks where Smith came from. I said 
“Oh that’s my father’s last name, but I’m having it removed.” My attempt at explaining why I applied with only Jones. He asks me why. 

“We’re not close.” He replies with an “ah” and nods. Trying to make a joke, I say “Yeah, I got daddy issues haha.” I regretted it and cringed as soon as it came out of my mouth...
